{{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Fire |type2=Dragon |trainername=Kiawe |pokemonname=Turtonator |jtrainername=カキ |jpokemonname=バクガメス |tmtrainername=Kaki |tmpokemonname=Bakugames |gender=MaleConfirmed in ''[[SM123|A Fiery Training Camp Trick!]]''. |ability={{a|Shell Armor}} ([[#In the games|Games]] only)Confirmed through [[List of Japanese region serial code event Pokémon distributions in Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon#Kiawe's Turtonator|event distribution]]. |nature= Brave (Games only)| |image=[[File:Kiawe Turtonator.png|250px]] |caption=Kiawe's Turtonator |location=[[Akala Island]] |prevonum=776 |epnum=SM001 |epname=Alola to New Adventure! |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Kiawe]] |java1=[[Kenta Miyake]] |enva1=[[Marc Thompson]] }} '''Kiawe's Turtonator''' (Japanese: '''カキのバクガメス''' ''Kaki's Bakugames'') was one of the two original {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Kiawe}} in the [[Alola]] [[region]] prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Kiawe Akala Grand Trial.png|thumb|left|250px|Turtonator in the Akala grand trial]] ====Pre-series==== Prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', Kiawe first met Turtonator while he was delivering milk supplies. He saw it battling a {{p|Crawdaunt}} at a pond near [[Wela Volcano Park|Wela Volcano]] in order to defend a group of resident [[wild Pokémon]], but it was defeated. During his future deliveries, Kiawe witnessed Turtonator losing to Crawdaunt multiple times, until he finally decided to help it get stronger so that it could defeat the [[Pokémon category|Rogue Pokémon]]. During a {{pkmn|training}} session with [[Kiawe's Charizard]], Turtonator ended up learning {{m|Shell Trap}}, which allowed it to defeat Crawdaunt. After congratulating Turtonator on its victory, Kiawe tried to leave, only for Turtonator to ask to come with him, which he accepted. At some point, Turtonator was used in Kiawe's [[island challenge|grand trial]] against [[Olivia]] where he battled her {{TP|Olivia|Lycanroc}} on [[Akala Island]] in order to receive [[Kiawe's grandfather|his grandfather]]'s [[Z-Ring]]. ===={{aniseries|SM}}==== [[File:Kiawe and Turtonator.png|thumb|250px|Turtonator and Kiawe]] Turtonator debuted in ''[[SM001|Alola to New Adventure!]]'', being Kiawe's choice to battle [[Tupp]], [[Zipp]], and [[Rapp]], a trio of {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s. He was joined by {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}. Turtonator was shown to be a capable fighter, starting the battle by easily taking hits from {{p|Zubat}}'s {{m|Leech Life}} and {{p|Yungoos}}'s {{m|Bite}} attacks before countering them with Shell Trap. After Ash and Pikachu gained the upper hand, Kiawe had Ash stand back to allow Turtonator to finish the fight. Calling out to Turtonator, the [[Firium Z]] on Kiawe's Z-Ring glowed, and after a series of synchronized poses, Turtonator unleashed his [[Z-Move]], {{m|Inferno Overdrive}}, wiping out Team Skull's Pokémon, forcing the Grunts to retreat. In ''[[SM034|A Crowning Moment of Truth!]]'', Kiawe used Turtonator to battle an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Marowak}} that had stolen the treasured "Wela Crown", an item said to boost the power of the Pokémon wearing it, from Wela Volcano Park. During the battle, Turtonator was shown being able to use {{m|Dragon Tail}}. However, Turtonator ended up getting defeated by the Bone Keeper Pokémon, with even his Z-Move failing to hit his target. Later, after receiving some encouraging words from Ash, Kiawe agreed to have a practice battle between Pikachu and Turtonator in order to be ready for a rematch with Marowak. During the battle, Turtonator ended up learning a new [[move]], which boosted Kiawe's confidence even further. The next day, Kiawe challenged Marowak again. With his new move, {{m|Shell Smash}}, Turtonator was able to gain enough {{stat|Speed}} to keep up with Marowak, allowing him to defeat his opponent this time around and retrieve the stolen crown. After the battle, {{TP|Kiawe|Marowak}} chose to join Kiawe's [[Party|team]]. [[File:SM043.png|thumb|250px|left|Turtonator battling Steelix]] In ''[[SM043|When Regions Collide!]]'', Turtonator battled [[Brock's Steelix]]. Turtonator started the battle with {{m|Flamethrower}} which Steelix deflected with {{m|Gyro Ball}} to reduce the damage. Turtonator was then squeezed by Steelix's {{m|Bind}}, but freed himself using Shell Trap. Recovering from the attack, Turtonator tried to use Dragon Tail. Before he could hit though, Steelix burrowed underground with {{m|Dig}} and struck Turtonator with the supereffective move. When Kiawe decided to use his Z-Move, {{an|Brock}} revealed his [[Key Stone]] and [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolved]] Steelix into Mega Steelix. Kiawe then had Turtonator attack with Inferno Overdrive, scoring a direct hit. Steelix, however, was able to endure the Z-Move and retaliated with {{m|Stone Edge}}. Turtonator attempted to tear through the move with Dragon Tail, but was overpowered, knocking him out, making Steelix the winner. In ''[[SM053|Rescuing the Unwilling!]]'', Turtonator and Marowak were used to fight {{an|Lusamine}}'s {{p|Salazzle}}, which was under {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Nihilego}}'s control, to allow Ash to save Lusamine. Salazzle was hit simultaneously with Marowak's {{m|Bonemerang}} and Kiawe and Turtonator's Inferno Overdrive. However, [[SM054|the next episode]] revealed that despite the critical damage dealt to it, Salazzle was forced to continue fighting by Nihilego. The battle ended when Ash and Pikachu performed {{m|10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt}} to defeat Nihilego. In ''[[SM070|The Young Flame Strikes Back!]]'', Turtonator helped Kiawe against [[Viren]] and [[Viren's henchmen|his henchmen]]. He was knocked out after protecting [[Mimo]] from {{p|Electivire}}'s {{m|Thunder}}. In ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', Turtonator joined the rest of Alola in showering {{an|Necrozma}} with light so it could return to its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|normal form}}. [[File:SM135.png|thumb|250px|Turtonator battling Lycanroc]] In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', Turtonator was used in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round of the [[Manalo Conference]]. With help from {{an|Lillie}} and [[Snowy]], he was able to defeat a {{p|Salamence}}, and later defeated an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Sandslash}}. Eventually, he came across [[Mad Magmar]] and [[Mr. Electric]], and with a combination of Shell Smash and Dragon Tail, he was able to knock out their {{p|Magmortar}} and Electivire, respectively. Turtonator was also the one to finish the Battle Royal, using Inferno Overdrive to defeat a {{p|Metagross}} and allowing Kiawe to progress to the next round. In ''[[SM135|The Final Four!]]'', Kiawe chose Turtonator as his second and final Pokémon during his semifinals battle with {{an|Gladion}}, sending him out to face {{TP|Gladion|Lycanroc}}. Despite taking multiple hits, Turtonator managed to endure Lycanroc's attacks and learn {{m|Focus Blast}}, which he used to defeat his opponent. Afterwards, Gladion sent out {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}}, which Turtonator began battling in the [[SM136|following episode]]. After Silvally got its foot stuck in the ground, Kiawe attempted to finish the battle with an Inferno Overdrive, but Gladion used the [[Fire Memory]] to {{a|RKS System|change Silvally's type}} just before the move hit, allowing it to endure the Z-Move and finish Turtonator off with {{m|Crush Claw}}, eliminating Kiawe from the tournament. In ''[[SM140|Z-Move Showdown!]]'', after a trio of {{p|Guzzlord}} invaded the Manalo Conference, Kiawe and Turtonator combined their Z-Move with those of the other Trainers, knocking the second {{Shiny}} {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Shiny Guzzlord|Guzzlord}} back into Ultra Space. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== In ''[[JN037|That New Old Gang of Mine!]]'', Turtonator had a battle against [[Goh's Raboot]], which was eventually called off after Turtonator used Inferno Overdrive. In ''[[JN131|Paring Pokémon While Parrying!]]'' and ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Turtonator watched Ash's match against {{an|Leon}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Harper Sarah Turtonator.png|thumb|250px|Harper and Sarah after touching Turtonator's spikes]] Turtonator is a very powerful and defensive {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, being able to take multiple hits from [[Team Skull]]'s Pokémon without showing any signs of damage. He has a trusting relationship with his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, as Kiawe confidently sends him into battle with his {{TP|Kiawe|Charizard}} on the line. He is also a friendly Pokémon, as first shown in ''[[SM014|Getting to Know You!]]'', where he got along with the other Pokémon and even allowed {{Ash}} and {{ashcl}}'s Pokémon to play on his back. His friendly nature was shown again in ''[[SM027|A Glaring Rivalry!]]'', when he joined the other Pokémon in taking part in a {{p|Charjabug}} train. In ''[[SM030|The Ol' Raise and Switch!]]'', however, he felt uncomfortable when the energetic [[Harper and Sarah]] were jumping on his back. Turtonator also likes having his back brushed. Turtonator is very kind and helpful when it comes to helping other Pokémon. For example, in ''[[SM015|Rocking Clawmark Hill!]]'', he helped {{AP|Rockruff}} dodge moves; and in ''[[SM022|A Shivering Shovel Search!]]'', he helped {{AP|Litten}} to master {{m|Fire Fang}}. He also shows affection towards someone by biting onto the person's head, as seen in ''[[SM031|The Island Whisperer!]]'' when he bit [[Olivia]]'s head. In spite of Turtonator being a very stoic Pokémon, he is able to get agitated, as shown in ''[[SM034|A Crowning Moment of Truth!]]'' and ''[[SM035|Currying Favor and Flavor!]]'', where he got annoyed with [[Kiawe's Marowak]] for trying to attack him and then proceeding to get its head stuck inside the hole in Turtonator's chest. Turtonator's rivalry with Marowak even extends to him glaring at Marowak while eating his food. Just like his Trainer, Turtonator is protective of [[Mimo]], as seen in ''[[SM070|The Young Flame Strikes Back!]]'' when he stepped in to protect her from {{p|Electivire}}'s {{m|Thunder}} without Kiawe's command. In ''[[SM106|Evolving Research!]]'', much like the rest of Kiawe's Pokémon, he greatly enjoys the taste of [[Poni Island]] radishes. In ''[[SM110|Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!]]'', Turtonator was shown to be a voice of reason when he tried to calm down his eccentric Trainer. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|fire|dragon|Kiawe Turtonator {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Shell Trap|1=Flamethrower|2=Dragon Tail|3=Shell Smash|4=Focus Blast}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Shell Trap|1=Flamethrower|2=Dragon Tail|3=Shell Smash|4=Focus Blast}}}} {{anmov|fire|Shell Trap|SM001|Alola to New Adventure!}} {{anmov|fire|Flamethrower|SM011|Young Kiawe Had a Farm!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|dragon|Dragon Tail|SM034|A Crowning Moment of Truth!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Shell Smash|SM034|A Crowning Moment of Truth!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|fighting|Focus Blast|SM135|The Final Four!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|dragon}} ====[[Z-Move]]s used==== {{anmov/h|fire|dragon|Kiawe Turtonator Inferno Overdrive.png|Using Inferno Overdrive}} {{anmov|fire|Inferno Overdrive|SM001|Alola to New Adventure!{{tt|*|Base move is Shell Trap or Flamethrower}}}} {{anmov/f|dragon}} ====Moves improvised==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; border: 3px solid #{{dragon color dark}}; {{roundy}}" |- ! ''{{color2|000|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon}}'' |} ==In the games== ===In the core series=== ====Ash's Classmates' Partner Pokémon==== {{bulbanews/3|Mallow's Steenee, Kiawe's Turtonator, Lillie's Vulpix codes to be distributed at Æon in Japan|Ash's classmates' Pokémon to be distributed at Pokémon Centers, Stores in Japan|Kiawe's Turtonator codes to be available at Homeplus in South Korea}} A Japanese event distributed an in-game representation of Kiawe's Turtonator, along with [[Mallow's Steenee]] and [[Snowy|Lillie's Alolan Vulpix]] via serial code and local wireless. The serial codes were available at {{wp|AEON (company)|Æon}} stores in Japan from June 26 to July 4, 2017, and could be used until July 14, 2017. The local wireless were available at {{OBP|Pokémon Center|store}} stores and [[Pokémon Store]]s in Japan from July 22 to August 13, 2017. The same Turtonator [http://pokemonkorea.co.kr/news/738 was] [https://web.archive.org/web/20170804163430/http://pokemonkorea.co.kr/page/83 distributed] to players who inserted a serial code that was given away at various {{wp|Homeplus}} and {{wp|Toys "R" Us}} stores in {{pmin|South Korea}} on August 5, 6, 12 and 26, 2017. The serial code was distributed to those who completed all seven trials of the Alola Challenge (Korean: 알로라 챌린지 ''Alola Challenge''). The serial codes could be used to obtain Turtonator from August 12 to September 30, 2017. {{G7event/head |ball=Cherish |pokemon=Turtonator |ndex=776 |type=Fire |type2=Dragon |gender=m |level=30 |metlevel=27 |ot={{tt|カキ|Japanese}}
